name: MV.tech Solutions
summary: MV.tech Solutions is a software development, data engineering and AI services company with offices in New York, USA, and Ahmedabad, India. Founded in 2022, it builds business applications, data platforms, reporting systems, AI integrations and automated workflows. Services include project delivery, dedicated engineering teams, IT staff augmentation and technology recruitment for clients in the USA and worldwide, with collaboration hours agreed per engagement.
shortSummary: Software development, data engineering, BI and AI services, with offices in New York, USA, and Ahmedabad, India.

founder.name: Meet Vaghasia
founder.description: Meet Vaghasia is the founder of MV.tech Solutions. He is a senior data and AI engineer who builds ETL pipelines and cloud warehouses on BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift and PostgreSQL, semantic and reporting layers for Power BI, Tableau and Looker Studio, and AI automation using RAG, MCP servers and custom AI connectors. He is Toptal-vetted (Top 3%) and holds the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification and IBM Big Data Engineer and Artificial Intelligence Analyst Mastery Awards.
